settings.overview: Choose a program on the seven-inch screen, then settle into one of two recline positions. The rollers follow an SL track from neck to hips. Of the three chairs in this edit, the Favor-27 takes up the least depth when fully reclined.
settings.features:
3D rollers on an SL track
16 automatic programs
Two zero-gravity positions
7-inch touchscreen
Lumbar heat
26 air cells
Foot rollers and extendable footrest
Bluetooth audio and USB charging

settings.overview: The PS5200 gives you separate control over roller intensity and air pressure, each with five settings. Choose from 20 automatic programs, add lower-back warmth, or use the foot rollers while you recline.
settings.features:
4D rollers on an SL track
20 automatic programs
Two zero-gravity positions
Five roller intensity levels and five air pressure levels
30 air cells
Shoulder detection
Lumbar heat and foot rollers
Touch controls and wireless charging

settings.overview: The PS6500 pairs a long 4D roller track with three recline positions. Save a favorite routine, change supported settings by voice, and choose from 25 ambient sounds. Allow 74.02 inches for the reclined chair itself, plus the clearance required for placement.
settings.features:
4D rollers on a long SL track
27 automatic programs
Three zero-gravity positions
7-inch touchscreen and voice control
Favorite settings
28 air cells
Lumbar heat and foot rollers
25 ambient sounds
Bluetooth audio and wireless charging
